liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **Wordless**: back after 24 archived shows (475 days); rare: 5 archived performances [7]
- **Stop Draggin' My Heart Around**: rare: 3 archived performances [7]

## The recordings

- **mmj2011-08-19.flac** (recommended): source not stated; 20 songs; 124 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds this recording clearer and brighter than other posted versions; Audio is slightly muffled and flat in places, but highly listenable for an audience recording [5][6]
- **mmj2011-08-19.m934c.m221b.flac24**: source not stated; 20 songs; 124 min [2]
- **mmj2011-08-19.m934c.m221b.flac16**: source not stated; 20 songs; 124 min [3]
- **mmj2011-08-19.m934c.m221b-mk5.m222.flac16**: source not stated; 20 songs; 124 min [4]

## Around the show

- Attendee recalls the performance as a pretty solid show based on re-listening [6]
- Venue manager escorted the recording team to the GA pit after checking with the band [1]
- Phosphorescent and Neco Case opened the show at the new Tuscaloosa Amphitheater [1]
- Neko Case joined the band onstage for this specific Tom Petty track [2]
- Neko Case was expected to join the band onstage, as she had at other tour stops [8]
- The blog post mentions a prayer for those who are physically starving [9]
- This recording is considered better than other posted versions of the same show [5]

## Tapers and lineage

- **mmj2011-08-19.flac**: taped by MSTaper with willSFC; transferred by MSTaper; source: Avantone CK-1 (cardoid) > Fostex FR-2LE (24/48) [1]
- **mmj2011-08-19.m934c.m221b.flac24**: taped by Taylor Caine; transferred by taylorc; source: [24bit] Schoeps m934c(cardioid)> M221B> EAA PSP-2> SD 744t (@24bit/96kHz) [2]
- **mmj2011-08-19.m934c.m221b.flac16**: taped by Taylor Caine; transferred by taylorc; source: [16bit] Schoeps m934c(cardioid)> M221B> EAA PSP-2> SD 744t (@24bit/96kHz) [3]
- **mmj2011-08-19.m934c.m221b-mk5.m222.flac16**: taped by Taylor Caine; transferred by taylorc; source: [16bit] Schoeps m934c(cardioid)> M221B> EAA PSP-2 + Schoeps mk5(omni)> KC5> M222> NT222> Aeta PSP-3> SD 744t (@24bit/96kHz) [4]
